scope: Passive material-print feasibility on development states, not a sensor for the controller. Only material row index 8 (the ninth 1-mm cell), central column 11. Predetermine a different fixed ink on each of its two existing triangles; colour does not depend on face liveness, oracle length, time, observer or goal. In a frozen diagnostic compare original / same triangles with inks / restored, all other shapes including scissors remain visible.
inputs: Reproduce both loaded controls and the last working states of a and b. Match the original same-state native RGB/depth, structural nodes/links, controller without probe, TCP and tick before probing. Use the actual sensor at 2560x1920. Also reproduce the previously verified 3-mm closed-jaw observation RGB-D, using the same guarded backoff with unchanged connectivity; not a parked substitute.
criteria: Report raw changed pixel counts and maximal 8-connected component for each ink, tolerance 3 RGB units. Require >=4 connected changed ink pixels per intact triangle in each loaded reference, and on the surviving triangle at the 8-mm working position for a positive presence signal. Absence at 9 never proves severance. Do not treat the two cases as independent confirmation. Before/after identical simulation time, PSM TCPs, camera pose, tissue nodes and links, no added closure. Exact native and high-res RGB-D restoration necessary. Record before-vs-ink depth changes separately; no changed-depth pixel may count as evidence of visible ink. Even a passing witness is at most evidence to REFUSE a premature STOP, never a standalone authorization.
